title: A survival institute warns data-center neighbors could be AI targets
teaser: A report by the Collapse Survival Institute warns that people living near AI data centers could be targeted if artificial general intelligence escapes human control. The report, written by retired Air Force colonel Drew Miller, urges Congress to halt new AI data-center construction and require shutdown mechanisms and transparency from developers of advanced models. Those proposals rest on a speculative scenario, but the warning lands amid real disputes over data centers’ noise, pollution and effect on electricity bills.
